de: The Acts of Union 1800 are passed which merge the Kingdom of Great Britain and the Kingdom of Ireland into the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland.

de: French Revolutionary Wars: Battle of the Nile (Battle of Aboukir Bay): Battle begins when a British fleet engages the French Revolutionary Navy fleet in an unusual night action.

te: British scientist Joseph Priestley discovers oxygen gas, corroborating the prior discovery of this element by German-Sw…
dz: 英国科学家约瑟夫·普里斯特利发现了氧气气体,证实了德意志-瑞典化学家卡尔·威廉·舍勒先前发现这一元素.
de: British scientist Joseph Priestley discovers oxygen gas, corroborating the prior discovery of this element by German-Swedish chemist Carl Wilhelm Scheele.

t: 明登战役，英德联军战胜法国。在英国，这是构成 1759 年奇迹周年的众多事件之一，并被某些英国…
te: The Battle of Minden, an allied Anglo-German army victory over the French. In Britain this was one of a number of event…
dz: 七年战争：明登战役，英德联军战胜法国。在英国，这是构成 1759 年奇迹周年的众多事件之一，并被某些英国陆军团庆祝为“明登日”。
de: Seven Years' War: The Battle of Minden, an allied Anglo-German army victory over the French. In Britain this was one of a number of events that constituted the Annus Mirabilis of 1759 and is celebrated as Minden Day by certain British Army regiments.

dz: 汉诺威选帝侯乔治出任大不列颠国王乔治一世,标志着格鲁吉亚时代英国历史的开始.
de: George, Elector of Hanover, becomes King George I of Great Britain, marking the beginning of the Georgian era of British history.

dz: 奥斯曼军队在圣高特哈德战役被雷蒙多·蒙特克科利所率领的奥地利军队所击败,导致瓦斯瓦尔和平.
de: Ottoman forces are defeated in the battle of Saint Gotthard by an Austrian army led by Raimondo Montecuccoli, resulting in the Peace of Vasvár.

dz: 法国的路易十一在安布瓦斯发现了被称作"圣米迦勒骑士团"的骑士勋章.
de: Louis XI of France founds the chivalric order called the Order of Saint Michael in Amboise.

t: 旧瑞士联邦随着联邦宪章的签署而成立。
te: The Old Swiss Confederacy is formed with the signature of the Federal Charter.
dz: 旧瑞士联邦随着联邦宪章的签署而成立。
de: The Old Swiss Confederacy is formed with the signature of the Federal Charter.

t: 阿莱克修斯四世·安杰洛斯 (Alexios IV Angelos) 在第四次十字军东征领导人的…
te: Alexios IV Angelos is crowned Byzantine co-emperor after his father Isaac II Angelos is pressured to do so by the leade…
dz: 阿莱克修斯四世·安杰洛斯 (Alexios IV Angelos) 在第四次十字军东征领导人的压力下，其父亲伊萨克二世·安杰洛斯 (Isaac II Angelos) 被加冕为拜占庭共治皇帝。
de: Alexios IV Angelos is crowned Byzantine co-emperor after his father Isaac II Angelos is pressured to do so by the leaders of the Fourth Crusade.

t: 陶尔米纳是西西里最后一个拜占庭据点,被阿格拉比德军队所俘,结束了穆斯林对西西里岛的征服.
te: Taormina, the last Byzantine stronghold in Sicily, is captured by the Aghlabid army, concluding the Muslim conquest of …
dz: 陶尔米纳是西西里最后一个拜占庭据点,被阿格拉比德军队所俘,结束了穆斯林对西西里岛的征服.
de: Taormina, the last Byzantine stronghold in Sicily, is captured by the Aghlabid army, concluding the Muslim conquest of Sicily.

te: Justinian I becomes the sole ruler of the Byzantine Empire.
dz: 查士丁尼一世成为拜占庭帝国的唯一统治者。

dz: 巴塔维安叛乱:由盖乌斯·朱利叶斯·公民(英语:Gaius Julius Civilis)领导的日耳曼尼亚因费里奥尔(荷兰)的巴塔维安人起义.
de: Batavian rebellion: The Batavians in Germania Inferior (Netherlands) revolt under the leadership of Gaius Julius Civilis.
